P04_AVOIDABLE_PARTICIPANT_WAIT.explanation: P04 requires an explicit breakdown of mandatory meal, hard transition, hard preparation and structurally unavoidable waiting before avoidable waiting can be measured.

P05_CRITICAL_RESOURCE_PRESENCE.explanation: P05 is blocked until effective resource assignments and relevance/presence policy are supplied for the evaluated planning.

P06_SPACE_CONTINUITY_UTILIZATION.explanation: P06 must not infer capacity or continuity from labels; effective day configuration is required.

P08_MOVES_ZONES.explanation: P08 requires effective spatial hierarchy and transition contracts to distinguish mandatory from avoidable moves.

P10_ROBUSTNESS_SLACK.explanation: P10 requires the configured robustness threshold and effective hard-transition slack; no A2-specific threshold is assumed.

qualityEvaluatorLimitations.legacyP09SequenceCheck: planningQuality.specialOperationQuality checks sequenceAfterJointGroupId with exact adjacency. Alfombra ends 1110; Totales Post starts 1115. Full effective validatePlan accepts the independent operation and its 5-minute participant margin. The legacy scorer returns jointViolationCount=1 identically for baseline and alternatives; it cannot certify global parity/Pareto.
